dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Shush! Are you here to "stock up"?

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Keep your voice down, and I can show you some real goodies...

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Exactly! The goods at International Groceries are premium products imported from merchants all over the world. We've got them in all types and categories. I'm sure you'll like one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Shh! The walls have ears, friend!

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: These are imported goods! I've never heard of this smuggling nonsense, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: I see that you're an outlander as well. You understand what we're about, right?

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: If you need anything, remember to help a brother out.

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Check with me first if you ever need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Sincerity is a key part of doing business, is it not? Just treat it as a gift from a friend.

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Nothing ventured, nothing gained, right? I'll be seeing you around!
